facts.anchor: Elise pulls a muscle in her neck trying to do an unsupported headstand
facts.fact: 早上杂技课上，Elise 尝试做无支撑头倒立时拉伤了脖子肌肉，并且做不了侧手翻。

facts.anchor: spend twenty minutes searching the area for materials to use to develop your personage
facts.fact: Tomas 在楼上要求学员用二十分钟在周边寻找材料，用来发展自己的“personage”。

facts.anchor: What about the garbage bins behind the hair salons near Château d’Eau?
facts.fact: Elise 提议去 Château d’Eau 附近发廊后面的垃圾桶翻找材料，比如假发。

facts.anchor: There is no name on it, only numbers, a date: 09 /09 /09.
facts.fact: Catherine 在街边绿色圆柱广告柱里的海报上没看到名字，只看到数字和一个日期 09 /09 /09。

facts.anchor: to the French man in skinny jeans that she wants the Bonjour Tristesse hair
facts.fact: Elise 走进运河附近一家发廊，对穿紧身牛仔裤的法国男发型师说她要剪“Bonjour Tristesse”那种发型。

facts.anchor: Elisabeth reveals two silver clamshell phones, one in each palm.
facts.fact: 见面时 Elisabeth 摊开双手，一手一只，亮出买到的两部银色翻盖手机。

facts.anchor: Seb always called her Beth; it was a name that was only between them.
facts.fact: Seb 一直叫女儿 Beth，这个名字只在他们两人之间使用。

facts.anchor: Finally, her daughter says, “I actually go by Elise now.”
facts.fact: 晚餐中女儿最终告诉 Catherine，她现在自称 Elise。
